catalog.note: maxCapabilities is PER REQUEST (what one /api/agent/turn may carry; the server refuses more). maxRegistered bounds the browser catalog. routingThreshold is the routed budget per request. No routing group may exceed maxGroupSize, so any single group (plus the always-on group) fits one request.

approval.note: APPROVAL BOUNDARY (live test 2026-10-28: auto-apply). An explicitly requested change applies at once when every action is risk 'local' and reversible; an action with risk 'confirm' or reversible false is always proposed - the server turns such an 'apply' into a 'propose' (turn.enforce_approval) and the browser's policy.decideMode does again. explicitOk = the only actions whose no-card path the browser may decide from the member's own words (their confirmIf still applies).
